name: jwt
summary: Opt-in JWT bearer-token authentication: typed, secret-redacted configuration, HS256 issue/verify with issuer, audience and TTL checks, and composable net/http middleware that puts validated claims on the request context. Installing it issues no token and guards no route until you wire a policy or middleware.

changes.summary: the token lifetime is a Go duration: jwt.ttl (15m, 120h) and JWT_TTL replace jwt.ttl_seconds and JWT_TTL_SECONDS, which keep working as deprecated fallbacks; the duration form wins when both are set
actions: replace config.JWT.TTLSeconds with config.JWT.TTL (a time.Duration) in project code and tests, and DefaultJWTTTLSeconds with DefaultJWTTTL
optionally change ttl_seconds: 900 to ttl: 15m in config.yml and JWT_TTL_SECONDS to JWT_TTL; a unitless ttl: 900 fails to load
